title: George Washington Conduct Night Flight Operations
description: Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George Washington (CVN 73) conducts night flight operations while transiting the Indian Ocean, Aug. 18. 2026. George Washington, operating in the U.S. 7th Fleet area of operations, is the U.S. Navy's premier forward-deployed aircraft carrier, a long-standing symbol of the United States' commitment to maintaining a free and open Indo-Pacific, while operating alongside allies and partners across the U.S. Navy's largest numbered fleet. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Robert S. Price)
